sights.n: Jungle Osaka Nipponbashi Honten (ジャングル 大阪日本橋本店)
sights.w: Den Den Town collectors' shop stacked with new and vintage figures, tokusatsu, Gunpla and retro toys; Osaka Metro's OsakaMania figure-shop series calls it the shop with the most momentum in Nipponbashi, and OSAKA-INFO gives it its own pop-culture spot page.
sights.anime: Figures & retro toys — a Nipponbashi otaku-street institution for anime, tokusatsu and Gundam collectibles

sights.n: Kotobukiya Nipponbashi (コトブキヤ日本橋)
sights.w: Green-signed flagship of the plastic-model and figure maker: Ghibli, Nintendo, Square Enix and Marvel/Star Wars goods on 1F, current anime/game figures and modelling tools on 2F; in OSAKA-INFO's Nipponbashi pop-culture guide and OsakaMania's figure-shop series.
sights.anime: Kotobukiya — figure/plastic-model maker's own Osaka store (anime, game and Ghibli character goods)
